key_insight: A transfer-learning + hybrid Cross-Entropy/Lovász optimization strategy makes BiSeNetV2 much more robust to reflective weld seams without adding model complexity.
engineering_relevance: This offers a lightweight, real-time seam segmentation upgrade for construction welding robots operating under harsh lighting and specular metallic reflections.
method: Start from a BiSeNetV2 backbone and apply transfer learning to stabilize training.
Use a hybrid Cross-Entropy + Lovász loss to improve boundary-aware seam segmentation.
Keep the architecture unchanged to preserve FLOPs, parameters, and inference speed.
evidence_signal: The proposed method reached 81.76% Joint IoU and 90.73% mIoU, improving Joint IoU by 22.36 points over the OHEM baseline while recovering 96.33% of severe zero-IoU failures.
watch_item: Performance gains are reported on challenging reflective welding data, so deployment should still be validated for new site lighting, surface finishes, and seam geometries.
paper_title: Enhanced Seam Segmentation for Automated Welding Robot in Construction Through Transfer Learning: Addressing Limitations of Bilateral Segmentation Network
